entries.title: Han
entries.body:
## Physical Description

Han is a female Velnorca, with her color scheme following the, rather common, one of black and white, with her primary color being white. She's shorter then average, at around 7.4ft tall, and weighs about 180kg,

Her most distinguishing feature is her bioluminescence, which, unlike other Velnorca, is unusually reactive and bright you can tell exactly how she's feeling and how intense that feeling is just at a glance, with this condition being named 'Luminescence Syndrome', when an usually high amount of the chemical that creates the bioluminescence is found.

## Position

Han is a Councillor of Solveyra, having been elected twice in her life, both in the most recent elections, with her main talking point during elections being about bringing the Pods closer together for a more unified state.

In recent history her following has only grown more due to her having became the 'vessel' of Ysmaruun, the eel like leviathan, which directly led to the discovery of FTL travel for Solveyra.

## History

Han grew up in a pod of deep sea miners, being the firstborn of a family, she spent most of her time within the Abyss helping her father, Laro, out with Elenaric Crystal extraction, primarily by making good use of her condition to provide ample light. However when Han was 7 her mother died giving birth to her little brother, Shin, this death deeply affected Han, but more so it affected Laro, whom deteriorated rapidly due to Velnorca mating for life, with the eventual outcome being his suicide, something rather common in Velnorcan society, especially those with mates.

The death of both her father and mother nearly caused Han to follow suit, but the prospect of leaving Shin, whom at this point was only a year old, alone without family drove her away from committing, instead she decided to find new purpose in aiding other families come together, doing her best to build a community for her pod.

When Han became 20 she decided to try and run for Councillor, securing herself a seat, with most of her first term being spent focused on trying to figure out how being a Councillor works but also building connections between the various pods.

Her life was flipped around once again during her second term, in which the events of [[Lore:A History Uncovered || Thallasophobia|A History Uncovered || Thallasophobia]] took place, causing her to become the vessel if Ysnaruun in a deal that quickly led to the discovery of FTL and the complete rewriting of Velnorcan society.
